guidance.heading: 2026 guidance raised
section: • | The Company is raising and narrowing its guidance range for 2026. Revenues & income4 are expected to range between $810 million and $830 million, compared with the previous guidance range of $790 million to $820 million.
• | Adjusted EBITDA guidance increased to $575 to $590 million, up from $565 to $585 million previously.
• | The guidance increase primarily reflects operating results for the first nine months, electricity trading activity in Israel and higher electricity prices in Europe.
